current.proofScope: Source inspection only; no independent rerun. OrderedRemoval.Crown.no_polynomial_removal_bound states that the fixed 3×3 crown has no polynomial removal bound, for arbitrarily small distance parameters and arbitrarily large hosts, with arbitrary binary repairs. Lean uses a padded host; the exact copy count and the smaller written host are outside Lean.
